race.comment: ODIN'S MOUNT (4) has the clearest winning profile after going under by a nose in a BM58 at Ipswich, and his earlier fourth there was also sound despite late interference. He rises in grade, but two wins from two starts at this track and a solid 1350m profile make him the horse to beat. KINGSLAND (5) has been around the mark all campaign, with a third at this venue two back and a fair fourth as favourite at Toowoomba on heavy ground. He brings reliable place and track form, though he must turn that consistency into a win. IGOTCHA (9) is ready third-up after finishing strongly for third in a BM65 at Toowoomba and her record around 1350m keeps her right in the argument. CUSTO (16) comes out of Saturday BM65 company at Doomben, where he was fourth and this slightly easier assignment gives him a genuine chance.
